unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Now adjust your own computer
drDigitalIntro:
You have tried all of these on a practice computer. The last step is to try them on yours.
• Open Settings on your own computer and look for a section called Accessibility, Ease of Access, or Universal Access — the name varies.
• Change one thing. Look at the screen. Decide whether you prefer it.
• If you do not like it, change it straight back. That is the whole point of this unit.
• Do not try to set everything at once. One change a day is plenty.
drDigitalSuccess: Your computer should fit you, not the other way round.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then go and try one setting on your own computer.
